material.locator: 5 U.S.C. §551(1) (scope/definition of agency); §§553–559 (statutory procedures and powers, including rulemaking, adjudication, hearings, evidence and sanctions).
material.description: Supports the statutory component of the claim and demonstrates that U.S. federal agency authority/procedure is set by statute. The cited provisions do not independently establish all constitutional limits; the claim remains bounded to a general principle.
